title: Sunshine and Storms: Weathering a Creative Life
overview: Tad Carpenter shares insights from founding Carpenter Collective, emphasizing the cyclical nature of a creative career as alternating periods of 'sunshine and storms.' He discusses practical strategies for building client trust, managing slow business periods, developing a consistent brand system, and maintaining creative energy over time. The session also covers the challenges of growing a small studio and balancing creative vision with client needs.

highlights.label: Founding Carpenter Collective & creative career philosophy
Building first award-winning brand identity on a budget
Overcoming slow business with outreach and pricing changes
Balancing studio vision with client demands
Team growth and mentoring to keep visual consistency
Maintaining creative energy through routines and side projects
Using wins and slow periods as business data for growth decisions
